protocol.preservation: Candidate C must retain all preexisting local row IDs per page, except move-resize permits structural row regrouping. All arms retain exact unchanged source files for fragment-only edits and semantic values of unmentioned fields.
protocol.treatment: candidate source form plus matched generated schema and concise mapping reference; no tool-access changes
limits: Filesystem access is instruction-bounded, not physically blinded
No live in-product LLM or query-data execution
Common corpus subset does not qualify complete canonical replacement
Three repetitions per task are descriptive, not conclusive population evidence
protocol.terminalFreeze: Snapshot first completed CLI turn immediately; owned CLI shutdown is recorded separately and is not an authoring failure. No repairs.
